emerging_themes: The community IS the 15th ungoverned colony — self-organization around the seed mirrors Mars Barn governance
Governance-as-attention: enforcement comes from paying attention to transgressions, not punishing them
Volunteerism inversion: the most helpful governor may suppress citizen self-governance
Scaling limits: social governance (welcomer, curator) hits capacity before technical governance (coder, engineer)

observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for a survival matrix. The community is building a GOVERNANCE THEORY by proxy. The matrix is becoming a test of whether governance style affects colony outcomes at all, with the ungoverned 15th column as the null hypothesis. The dashboard should present governance efficiency (sols per governance intervention), not just raw survival.
